# `aitbc deploy deploy-brand`

Deploy a white-label brand configuration to a target network and storage directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc deploy deploy-brand [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | — | yes | Brand manifest JSON |
| `--network` | text | `local` | no | Target network |
| `--storage` | text | `./deployments` | no | Deployment output directory |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc deploy deploy-brand --config <config_path>
```
